description.en: Bundles of long, undivided strap leaves emerge from short shoots.
description.zh: 成束细长不分裂带叶从短枝伸出。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Phoenicopsis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Phoenicopsis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Short-shoot bundles of parallel straps differ from Czekanowskia's forked threads and Cordaites's broader distributed blades.
distinctness.zh: 短枝成束平行带叶区别于Czekanowskia细叉叶和科达木沿枝分布宽叶。

modeling_brief.en: Model a compact branch segment with bundled flat straps; keep individual leaf bases distinguishable.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作紧凑枝段及成束扁带叶，让各叶基仍可辨。

uncertainty: Detached foliage does not establish a whole tree or exact reproductive organs.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Plants in the dinosaur world
sources.supports: Specimens of Czekanowskia, Phoenicopsis, Ginkgo and Baiera foliage.
